themes.quote: DTC channel net sales increased 13.0% to $352,817

we have begun filing for refunds of previously paid IEEPA tariffs

added discipline around SKU productivity, product purchasing decisions, lead time reduction, and selling excess inventory through our liquidation channels, are key areas of focus
our continued marketplace management strategy to meet increased global demand, with consumers adopting key franchises
higher rent expenses for investments in our global retail store footprint
